title: The Fallen Survey Line
description: Fractured limestone drums, a fallen moulding and weathered ashlar in an eight-metre scatter.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: the drums are now hard cylinders with cut flutes, break faces are rough, the fragments are angular blocks, the drums are grouped. Not fixed: (1) the flutes read as broad shallow facets on a 10-12-sided polygon; raise the segment count and deepen the flutes with crisp fillets. (2) One drum end has an unexplained hollow cavity (closeup.jpg left drum). (3) Material: a uniform black pepper speckle covers every piece (terrazzo/foam look) instead of clean limestone with dirt only in recesses and at ground contact. (4) Pieces rest on the ground with no embedding, soil or grass contact (round-1 point 3). (5) There is still no fall line of one toppled column and no capital or cornice fragment with a readable profile (round-1 points 2 and 4).
